issue_context.title: Feature: Support for pushing git changes
issue_context.body:
### What feature or improvement do you think would benefit Files?

We have support for pulling changes so it makes sense to add support for pushing as well.

### Requirements

- Display the number of unpushed commits on the status bar
- Clicking the button will display menu flyout with the options to
   - push
   - pull

### Files Version

v2.4.85

### Windows Version

Windows 11 (22H2): 22621

### Comments

_No response_
comments: Do we need to list un-pushed commits somewhere?
Yes, but it'll have to wait for the git pane so users can commit the changes.

review_comments: The string isn't specific to Git so I'd rather keep it generic in case we want to use it somewhere else.
There should be a way for the user to use an SSH key or manually input a username/password if they don't use GitHub
Should I work on it in this PR?
